Name: Total Luck Control
Author: AditOliSamping
Description:
Total Luck Control gives you complete, granular control over every luck and RNG system in Stardew Valley. Instead of relying on the daily luck forecast, you decide exactly how lucky your world is from fishing treasure chests to rare mining drops, item quality, night events, and more.
Every systeym is independent. Enable only what you want, adjust sliders to taste, and the rest stays vanilla. All settings are accessible in-game via Generic Mod Config Menu.
[heading]Features[/heading]
Global luck
Override or multiply daily luck. Optional cheat mode bypasses all vanilla clamps for fishing and loot.

Fishing
Control bite rate, treasure chest chance, and treasure loot quality. Rare items like Prismatic Shard can appear in chests.

Mining
Faster ladder spawns, ore double drops, monster double drops, and rare item drops tiered by mine depth.

Loot systems
Boost geode rare gems, artifact spot finds, crate drops, and garbage can luck independently.

Item quality
Set dominant quality tier for crops, foraging, tree fruit, and bush berries. Boost forage spawn quantity up to 3×.

Night events
Tune the chance of fairy visits, witch events, meteor landings, and owl statues individually.

Traveling merchant
Inject rare items  Ancient Seeds, Dinosaur Eggs, Prismatic Shards into the merchant's daily stock.

Combat
Boost crit chance, add temporary ATK buffs on hit, or proc true damage that bypasses monster defense.

Seed maker
Increase Ancient Seed drop chance and bonus seed output quantity per machine cycle.
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Game version: 1.6+
SMAPI: 4.0+
GMCM: Optional
Merchant rare item rolls use a seeded RNG per day so results are consistent across shop opens.

Downloads.Description:
SMAPI — required
Generic Mod Config Menu — optional, but highly recommended for the in-game config UI
